segments.text: The Brihat Jataka says that with the Moon in Aquarius you will be
attached to the partners of other men
. With Venus in Aries, it warns of entanglements that cost property and reputation, since such a person
will lose his property through their influence and will bring disgrace on his family
. With Mercury in Taurus, it describes a person who
will have many sons and partners

sources.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aquarius] will be attached to the wives of other men and interested in the wicked deeds of other people;
A person born with Venus in sign Aries or Scorpio will be fond of the wives of other men, will lose his property through their influence and will bring disgrace on his family.
A person born with Mercury in sign Taurus or Libra will be a preacher, will have many sons and wives, will ever be engaged in earning money, will be liberal in gift and will respect his preceptor.

segments.text: With the Sun and Jupiter sharing a sign, the translator's notes say you will be
earnest in work, will be a favorite with someone with standing and rich
. The Brihat Jataka adds that with the Sun in Gemini you
will be learned in grammar, will be an Astrologer and will be rich
. With Jupiter in Gemini, the book says you
will be a minister and will live in comfort

sources.text: (4). The Sun and Jupiter, he will be earnest in work, will be a favorite with the king and rich.
A person born with the Sun in sign Gemini will be learned in grammar, will be an Astrologer and will be rich.
A person born with Jupiter in sign Gemini or Virgo will have many clothes, houses, servants, sons and friends, will be a minister and will live in comfort.

segments.text: With the Sun in your 10th house, the Brihat Jataka holds that you
get wealth from [your] father
, and with Jupiter there, that you get it
from [your] brother
. With Jupiter in Gemini, the book describes a home of
many clothes, houses, servants, sons and friends
. With Mars in Pisces, it notes a smaller family, since such a person
will have very few children

sources.text: [A person gets wealth from his] father [according as the planet which occupies the 10th house from the Lagna or from the Moon is] the Sun
[A person gets wealth from his] brother [according as the planet which occupies the 10th house from the Lagna or from the Moon is] Jupiter
A person born with Jupiter in sign Gemini or Virgo will have many clothes, houses, servants, sons and friends, will be a minister and will live in comfort.
A person born with Mars in sign Sagittari or Pisces will have many enemies, will be the king's minister, will be of wide-spread fame, will be fearless and will have very few children.

segments.text: With the Sun in your 10th house, the Brihat Jataka holds that wealth comes
from [your] father
, and with Jupiter there,
from [your] brother
. With Saturn in Capricorn, the book says you
will have a permanent wealth and authority and will enjoy the property acquired by him
. With the Moon in Aquarius, it warns that fortunes may
rise and fall by turns

sources.text: [A person gets wealth from his] father [according as the planet which occupies the 10th house from the Lagna or from the Moon is] the Sun
[A person gets wealth from his] brother [according as the planet which occupies the 10th house from the Lagna or from the Moon is] Jupiter
[A person born with Saturn in sign Capricorn or Aquarius] will have a permanent wealth and authority and will enjoy the property acquired by him.
[A person born with the Moon in sign Aquarius] will rise and fall by turns;

segments.text: The translator's notes add that with the Sun and Jupiter together, you
will be earnest in work, will be a favorite with someone with standing and rich
. With the Moon in Aquarius and aspected by Jupiter, the Brihat Jataka holds that you
will resemble someone with standing
. With the Sun in your 10th house, the book says you
will live in comfort and will be powerful

[If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy sign Aquarius] if aspected by Jupiter, he will resemble a King;
if he occupy the 10th house, the person will live in comfort and will be powerful;

segments.text: The Brihat Jataka describes a person with the Moon in Aquarius as
fond of flowers and perfumes; and will be attached to friends and will walk without feeling tired
. With the Moon in your 6th house, the book describes
a soft body, [and] a dull appetite
. It also notes a more restrained pace in romance and work, as such a person
will be sparing in sexual union
and
will be slow at work

sources.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aquarius] will be fond of flowers and perfumes; and will be attached to friends and will walk without feeling tired.
If she occupy the 6th house, the person from will be of soft body, will have a dull appetite
